summary: Select and crop an image with a pointer or numeric fields.
whenToUse: Cropping avatars and other images before saving or uploading them.
whenNotToUse: To display images without editing them, use ImageGallery.

props.name: onCrop
props.description: Receives the rectangle and the cropped Blob.

props.name: crop / defaultCrop / onCropChange
props.description: Rectangle in pixels of the original image.

props.name: mimeType / quality / onError
props.description: Blob format and quality, and error handling.

keyboard.action: Changes position and size via the numeric fields.

accessibility: The numeric fields let you select the same area without dragging.
responsive: The image resizes while keeping coordinates in original pixels.
commonMistakes: Remote images require correct CORS for the canvas to be read.
Saving and uploading remain the consumer's responsibility.
limits: Free-form rectangle, no rotation or fixed aspect ratio.
